title: PublicChartCandidates
description: Committed catalog of promoted SANITIZED_PUBLIC chart-data artifacts for the first public chart-data tranche. Each candidate references a locale-agnostic, numeric-only chart-data file under results/public/chart-data/** by stable keys/slugs only. No titles, legends, prose, private paths, endpoint/deployment names, request IDs, or human labels appear here. Pricing-provenance fields are excluded from chart payloads by construction; only contributing source digests are recorded.

schema_semver.description: Semantic version of this catalog contract.

tier.description: Release tier (docs/16). This catalog is tier-pinned to SANITIZED_PUBLIC.

candidates.description: One entry per emitted chart-data artifact.

stable_key.description: Lowercase, locale-agnostic stable key or slug (no prose, no human labels).

chart_data_path.description: Repo-relative path to the numeric chart-data artifact.

dimension_keys.description: Stable dimension (categorical axis) keys for the chart rows.

series_keys.description: Stable numeric value keys present in each chart row.

units_key.description: Stable units key for the metric (e.g. usd_per_request, milliseconds, tokens, factor).

tier.description: Release tier of the candidate artifact.

target_topic_slug.description: Stable, prose-free routing slug for the target blog topic.

source_sanitized_sha256.description: SHA-256(s) of the contributing SANITIZED_PUBLIC source artifact(s).

schema_semver.description: Semantic version of the chart-data payload contract.
